newsitem.title: USA: Northwest exercises option for 24 jets.
newsitem.headline: Northwest exercises option for 24 jets.

text.p: Northwest Airlines said Monday that it exercised previously announced options for the acquisition of twenty-four British Aerospace Avro RJ85 regional jet aircraft.
Deliveries will begin in May 1998 and will continue for a period of up to 48 months, a news release issued by Northwest said.

"The introduction of the RJ85 into Mesaba's fleet has been very popular with customers," said Michael E. Levine, Northwest executive vice president - marketing and international. "It allows expansion in markets where demand exceeds the capabilities of turboprops and entrance into new markets."

Northwest placed its initial order for twelve RJ85s and twenty-four options in October 1996 as part of an agreement with Mesaba Airlines, one of Northwest's Airlink affiliates, under which Mesaba agreed to lease and operate the RJ85, the news release said.
Deliveries began in April of this year and are continuing at the rate of one per month, the release said.
